intel.title: [CISA KEV] Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager - Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-76504
廠商: Cisco
產品: Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
漏洞名稱: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
說明: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-03
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager 存在 Hex 編碼處理不當漏洞（CVE-2026-76504），未經授權的遠端攻擊者可藉由特製的 HTTP 請求繞過驗證並取得管理員（admin）權限。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV），但由於本公司並未部署此產品，故不受影響。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
